proof_limits: Source top-level SHA256 proof inherited from pinned inventory/Phase1A; this pass freshly rechecks sizes, not all 1.58GB hashes.
ZIP central-directory entry CRC32 is metadata, not fresh CRC verification. Only explicit full_bytes_crc_rechecked_this_map=true proves this pass reached EOF.
Three AM07 CSV members have document-only whole-series coverage evidence, weaker than per-member JSON/hash audit; NSE/BSE JSON record/segment inspection is conservatively partial.
Unlocalized F&O/bhavcopy representative sampling is not assigned to arbitrary members; these remain inventory_only in this conservative ledger.
Exact duplicate candidates are not automatically promoted; source-context and applicability still need review.
ZIP member listing is immediate only; XLSX/DOCX internal package parts are not counted as separate release data files.
25 misleading .xls member extensions were confirmed as OOXML workbooks through bounded in-memory package-directory reads; their cells remain unread.
Ongoing root XLS/PDF/HTML and IFR audit results are excluded from this baseline until their separate evidence is accepted.
No runtime adoption, current provider readiness, historical identity or existing Mongo coverage is established by this map.
scope: evidence reconciliation and bounded signature/directory reads; not new full content review

status_definitions.corrupt: ZIP central directory cannot open; bytes preserved, member coverage unknown
status_definitions.inventory_only: names/sizes/signature and sometimes CRC/hash known, without whole content interpretation
status_definitions.partial: some members or representative rows reviewed; remaining contents unresolved
status_definitions.reviewed: all rows/stored cells/text or complete documented coverage scan has explicit evidence; not formula correctness, identity, upstream authority, currentness or activation
status_definitions.unread: content known not parsed or standalone asset with no content evidence
